{{Youmay|changelings, also known as shapeshifters|the [[Melodie]] [[Changeling (Melodie)|changelings]], or other uses of the word [[Shape (disambiguation)]]}}
[[File:Clawdite2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Clawdite taking on a new form while running from a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].]]
{{Quote|You know, a gentleman would turn his back while a lady changes.''"<br />"''That's not the sort of changing most people have in mind. And you're no lady.''"<br />"''Sometimes I am.|[[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]|<ref name="Zam Wesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref>}}
'''Changeling''' or '''Shapeshifter''' was a term used for those [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the [[Shi'ido]] or the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdites]], with the ability to change their appearance or shape.<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Because of the mistrust some beings had of shapeshifters, they would often try to hide their species of origin.<ref name="Noviee Exposed as a Changeling">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|sports/13516_1.html|Noviee Exposed as a Changeling}}</ref> Others were valued as [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Spy/Legends|spies]], and observers.<ref name="Attack of the Clones" />

Some beings were also able to [[Metamorphosis|transform]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by using the reflections of the life forces around them. Those species included the [[Celestial/Legends|Force wielders]].<ref name="Overlords">{{TCW|Overlords}}</ref>
